maintainer_statements.author: remvze
maintainer_statements.text: Hey there! All sounds are sourced from either [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/) or [Freesound](https://freesound.org/), except for the binaural beats, which I created myself. The license for Pixabay [doesn't require crediting](https://pixabay.com/service/license-summary/), while for Freesound, I've only selected sounds with a [CC0 license](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), which also doesn't require crediting.

maintainer_statements.author: remvze
maintainer_statements.text:
> Pixabay license is also not “free”, which means I’m not sure you can apply MIT on top of it.

Could you please specify which part of their license you are referring to?

maintainer_statements.author: remvze
maintainer_statements.text: Thank you for your suggestion. I've just included a license section in the README file. Could you please review it and confirm if this is what you meant?
